_comment: Governance inventory: mutating paths + EF optimistic concurrency on Order, InventoryItem, Shift (byte[] RowVersion). Payment / InventoryMovement rows remain untokenized.

entities.name: Order
entities.notes: Open→Paid and void transitions; RowVersion on Order — concurrent writers get DbUpdateConcurrencyException surfaced as HTTP 409 via handlers / global exception mapping.

entities.name: InventoryItem
entities.notes: Stock quantities updated during finalize and sync paths; RowVersion on InventoryItem — stale inventory updates fail concurrent SaveChanges (finalize inventory deductions compete safely when conflicts occur).

entities.name: InventoryMovement
entities.notes: Deduction rows created on finalize; sync processors can add movements — replay/duplicate sync can duplicate movements without durable per-operation idempotency on all processors.

entities.name: Shift
entities.notes: Shift cash state and lifecycle; RowVersion on Shift — concurrent close/cash-drop paths can conflict with 409; broader sync/outbox idempotency gaps remain separate debt.

entities.name: Payment
entities.notes: Payments added inside finalize transaction; Paid short-circuit avoids duplicate adds for same order, but no concurrency token on Payment rows for broader races.
